title: Laparoscopy for endometriosis
what: Through a few small cuts in the belly, the surgeon finds and removes areas of endometriosis. The surgery is done under general anesthesia.
why: For severe pain, infertility, or ovarian cysts, when treatment with pills does not help.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 2 hours; the hospital stay is usually 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes
If you had belly surgery before
If you had problems with anesthesia
If you plan to get pregnant

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, an ultrasound, and sometimes an MRI. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Bowel
prepare.text: Sometimes you are asked to empty your bowel the day before. The clinic will give you instructions.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food from the evening before and no drinks for a few hours before. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Your things
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes, slippers, pads, and a phone charger.

bring: Things for 1 to 3 days in the hospital
steps: On the day of surgery, you change, and an IV line is placed in your vein
In the operating room, you get anesthesia and fall asleep
The surgeon makes a few small cuts
A camera and tools are put in
Areas of endometriosis and cysts are removed, and sometimes tissue is taken for testing
You wake up in the recovery room
feel: After anesthesia, you may feel sleepy and sometimes sick
Pain in the belly and at the cuts. You will get pain medicine
Your shoulder often hurts from the gas. It goes away in 1 to 2 days
after: You are usually allowed to walk the same day or the next day
Do not lift heavy things for a few weeks
Sometimes hormones are prescribed after surgery
Tissue test results usually take 1 to 2 weeks
red_flags: Severe belly pain or pain that keeps getting worse
Redness or pus at the cuts

faq.q: Will endometriosis come back after surgery?
faq.a: Sometimes it comes back. That is why your doctor may prescribe treatment after surgery.

faq.q: When can I try to get pregnant?
faq.a: Usually soon after you recover. Your doctor will tell you when.

reminders.text: Surgery tomorrow. Pack your things, documents, and list of medicines. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
